purpose: Teach: 語句/教え子/腑/灌/學/実技/参謀/交錯

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、古文の難解な語句の読解を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you wrote your paper on the interpretation of difficult classical Japanese phrases, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, observant. Gentle confirmation — not a question, but an invitation to share. Steady eye contact. The tone of a teacher who has read the work and is genuinely curious about the thinking behind it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、亡くなった先生方の教え子の追悼を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I focused on a memorial study about the former teachers' students.
lines.style: Earnest but slightly uncertain. A quieter delivery, as if still processing the complexity of his own work. Respectful pause before the explanation, like he's choosing words carefully.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、東洋医学の五臓六腑の概念を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, your paper was on the five organs and six viscera concept in Eastern medicine, wasn't it?
lines.style: Gentle probe. Warm but weighted — acknowledging the depth of the subject. Slightly slower pace. The tone of someone testing to see if the student will gently correct her understanding.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、灌仏会、つまり花祭りの歴史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I actually wrote about the history of the Bathing Buddha ceremony, the flower festival.
lines.style: Quiet correction, not defensive. A small smile in the voice. Proud of the specificity but not making a show of it. Natural correction that moves the conversation forward.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、旧字体の學と新字体の学の歴史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you explored the history of the classical character 學versus the modern form 学, didn't you?
lines.style: Reflective, thoughtful. A moment of genuine curiosity — the teacher is testing her own memory or drawing out something specific. Warm but measured. Slight tilt of certainty.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、武道の実技審査の歴史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I focused on the history of practical martial arts examinations.
lines.style: Gently correcting again. Earnest tone, steady. Not annoyed, just precise — offering the actual topic with quiet confidence. A slight warmth, like he appreciates the chance to clarify.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、戦国時代の参謀役の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you wrote about the role of strategy advisors in the Sengoku period, right?
lines.style: Warmly reflective, slightly testing. The cadence of someone halfway through understanding and halfway drawing it out. Genuine engagement with the subject matter.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、政治と経済が交錯する事象を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I examined how politics and economics intersect within historical events.
lines.style: Earnest, closing with quiet confidence. A small sense of culmination — he's articulated something important. Slight warmth at the end, like relief at having found the right words.
